title: Ticket-Size Lining Discount Bands — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
A ticket-size lining discount applies to the lined surcharge for added work on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, from the total of the operation charges booked on the ticket.

| Total of operation charges booked on the ticket | Ticket-size lining discount |
|---|---|
| 100.00 USD or more | 10 percent |
| 60.00 to 99.99 USD | 5 percent |
| under 60.00 USD | none |

**What is totalled.** Every operation charge booked on the ticket, at its booked amount. Lined surcharge charges, rush fees and extra fitting fees are not operation charges and are not part of the total.

## Band edges, both sides

| Total | Discount |
|---|---|
| 59.99 USD | none |
| 60.00 USD | 5 percent |
| 99.99 USD | 5 percent |
| 100.00 USD | 10 percent |

## Hypothetical illustration

A ticket with operation charges of 28.00, 34.00 and 18.00 USD and a lined surcharge of 5.00 USD totals 80.00 USD of operation charges: 5 percent. Adding a further 24.00 USD operation charge brings the total to 104.00 USD: 10 percent.
